Under this leadership, capital allocation priorities are fully funding the business and new initiatives, maintaining strong liquidity and a healthy balance sheet, selective M&A to complement organic growth, and returning excess capital via buybacks, with $16-17bn spent on content assets in four of the last five years and over $21bn of repurchases in the past three years.
